content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Denver

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project experience, or equivalent—before applying. Granite PM Academy's enrollment team can help you verify your qualifications against PMI's requirements.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our nationally delivered program covers the PMBOK® Guide framework, exam domains, and real-world scenarios. Attend scheduled sessions on your own schedule, earn your certificate of completion, and receive the 35 contact hours PMI requires to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account, document your education and project experience, and submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Pay the associated exam fee and await PMI's review and approval. Processing typically takes several weeks; plan ahead so your approval arrives before your desired exam date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to solidify your knowledge. Register for your computer-based exam through Pearson VUE and sit for the four-hour, 180-question assessment. Your score arrives within five business days; a passing result earns you the PMP credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) across a standard three-year renewal cycle. PDUs come from training, conference attendance, volunteer leadership, and publication in your field. Renew your credential by submitting your PDU record and renewal fee to PMI before expiration to remain certified.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
